About Roomly

Built for Egypt. Built for trust.

Roomly is Egypt's most trusted room booking platform — connecting verified guests with quality hosts across 180+ cities.

Our Mission

Making every stay feel like home

We started Roomly because booking a room in Egypt was broken — no trust, no transparency, and no accountability. We set out to fix that.

Every listing on Roomly is verified. Every guest is ID-checked. Every review is from someone who actually stayed. That's the Roomly promise.
